body.name: Sign-invariant affine-chart compiler handle
body.construction: Starting from \(\Gamma_{\mathcal I}(G)\), refine every pivot chart by the signs of the exact-support coordinates, all rank and principal minors, every proportionality minor, and every numerator of a simultaneous response equality; intersect these cells with each finite source-surjection type, eliminate empty cells by constructive polynomial certificates, and canonicalize the surviving records under latent relabeling.
